seo_title: Recurring Billing API: Automate Your Subscriptions
seo_desc: Wasting days chasing monthly payments? We integrate Cloud payment APIs to automate your small business's subscriptions and recurring invoices.
author_pitch: As a Cloud Specialist, it is unbelievable to me to see small academy owners or maintenance companies wasting the first week of every month chasing clients to pay their fees. Demanding money damages the relationship and steals your productive time. I design cloud API integrations that connect payment gateways directly with your invoicing, automating recurring charges and invoices so the money arrives in your account without you having to ask for it.
title: The exhaustion of chasing unpaid bills: API Integration to automate your recurring payments
body:
Does your small business waste the first week of every month checking transfers and chasing clients to pay their monthly fee?

For freelancers and small businesses offering recurring services (like academies, marketing agencies, or maintenance companies), payday is a nightmare. You have to issue dozens of invoices by hand, send them by email, and cross your fingers that the client makes the transfer. Inevitably, many forget, and you are forced to make uncomfortable reminder calls. This manual process not only fractures your cash flow but also makes you lose entire days of administrative work claiming money that is already yours.

The trap of Paper SEPA Mandates and Excels

To try and secure payment, many businesses force their clients to sign physical SEPA mandates and manage bank remittances by exporting files from a chaotic Excel. Trusting the survival of your cash flow to a manual process where a simple formatting error rejects your entire billing is like playing financial Russian roulette.

Our solution: Cloud Recurring Billing API Integration

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we digitize your liquidity. As experts in Cloud architectures, we connect modern payment gateways (like Stripe or GoCardless) directly with your corporate management software through secure APIs, automating the entire payment lifecycle.

  1. Secure Card Tokenization: We integrate a Cloud portal where your client enters their card or bank account just once, encrypting the data in bank vaults under PCI-DSS regulations without you storing sensitive information.
  2. Synchronized Invoicing and Charging: On the first day of every month, the API issues the invoice in your ERP and automatically triggers the charge to the client's card, without you having to intervene.
  3. Smart Failed Payment Management (Dunning): If a payment fails due to insufficient funds or an expired card, the cloud system applies automatic strategic retries and sends warning emails to the client with a link to update their payment method.
  4. Automated Service Suspension: We connect the gateway with your platform so that, if the non-payment persists after several days, the system automatically suspends the client's access to your services or membership.

The Real Impact on your B2B Treasury

  • Zero Days of Payment Delay: Your business wakes up on the first day of the month with one hundred percent of the fees deposited in the bank, guaranteeing predictable and healthy liquidity.
  • Elimination of Commercial Friction: You and your team stop playing the role of debt collectors, maintaining a positive and purely professional relationship with your clients.
  • Total Administrative Automation: You say goodbye forever to generating manual bank remittances and repetitive invoices, freeing up entire days of work every month to focus on growing.
